basic_info.description: Beautiful Parkside home with stylish updates, a flexible floor plan, and access to excellent schools. This spacious 4BD/3BA single-family home offers 2,235 sq ft of thoughtfully improved living space on a 3,000 sq ft lot, blending 1920s charm with modern comfort and functionality.  The main level features three bedrooms and two remodeled bathrooms, a sun-filled living room, and a formal dining area ideal for everyday living or entertaining. Enjoy refinished hardwood floors, new interior paint, updated lighting, and a bright, updated kitchen with stainless steel appliances and ample cabinet space.  Downstairs, the lower level features a fourth en-suite bedroom, a laundry room, and a spacious family room with a fireplace that opens directly to the fenced backyard, creating a seamless connection between indoor entertaining and outdoor enjoyment. It's the perfect setup for multigenerational living, a guest suite, a home office, or teenage quarters.  A one-car garage, driveway parking, and extra storage complete the home. Just one block from the L-Taraval Muni line and close to Stern Grove, top-rated schools, and Taraval Street's cafes and shops, this move-in ready gem offers convenience, flexibility, and timeless appeal.
